title: Privacy Policy
lead: This page explains how we collect, use and protect your information when using our website and forms.

data.title: What we collect
data.text: We collect data you voluntarily provide through forms (e.g., name, email, message, and attachments) and basic technical information (e.g., browser and visited pages) to improve the experience.

security.title: How we protect
security.text: We apply technical and organizational measures to protect your data against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.

rights.title: Your rights
rights.text: You may request confirmation of processing, access, correction, update, or deletion of data when applicable. You may also withdraw consent.

contact.title: Privacy contact
contact.text: If you have questions or requests related to privacy, contact us via the email below.

collect.title: Collection
collect.i1: Data submitted through forms (Contact and Careers).
collect.i2: Uploaded files (e.g., PDF resume) when applicable.
collect.i3: Minimal technical data for operation and security.

use.title: Purpose
use.i1: Reply to messages and requests sent via the website.
use.i2: Process job applications and contact candidates.
use.i3: Maintain security, prevent abuse, and improve the service.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.p1: We may use strictly necessary and/or performance cookies to improve navigation. You can manage cookies in your browser.

share.title: Sharing
share.p1: We do not sell your data. We may share it only when needed to operate the service (e.g., email providers) or due to legal obligations.

notice.title: Important
notice.text: This policy is an informational summary and may be updated to reflect improvements, legal changes, or operational changes.

footerNote: By using this website, you agree to this Privacy Policy.
